messages:
Asha (PM): Heads-up — Prospect (Orchid) wants private deploy + HSM-managed keys + p95 SLA (tight). Staging goal: EoQ.
Liam (Runtime Eng): HSM + p95 in private is achievable but needs KV prefix caching, quant checks, and a fallback model. Also need a small canary window.
Priya (Infra): We have one spare prewarm slot but it's reserved for Beacon. We can reassign if Beacon accepts a 2-week shift or burst capacity.
Asha (PM): Orchid says they'll accept a staged canary (10% -> 40% -> 100%) if we have clear gating.
Jules (Security): HSM integration requires attestation + light pen test. Rough SLAs: attestation/config ~8-10 business days, pen test ~3-5 days after infra ready. Need key policy signed before prod.
Liam (Runtime Eng): Runtime action items: HSM plugin config, enable KV caching early, quant smoke tests, fallback routing. I can draft rollout playbook + rollback hooks in 2 sprints if infra slot confirmed.
Priya (Infra): If we transfer the slot, VPC peering + routing + NATs ready in ~6 business days. Need final region and slot decision by EOD Tue.
Asha (PM): Proposed canary gating: (1) HSM attestation complete; (2) pen test no critical findings; (3) canary metrics: error_rate <0.5% and p95 within SLA for 48h. Also require token-level telemetry and a regression prompt set.
Liam (Runtime Eng): Agree. I'll include this snippet in the playbook:
```yaml
canary:
  - percent: 10
    duration: 48h
  - percent: 40
    duration: 72h
rollback_on:
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
  - p95_latency_increase_pct: 15
```
Jules (Security): Ping me when infra is live. I'll book attestation and pen test windows and prepare the key policy template.
ops-bot: Reminder: please add ticket "Orchid private pilot" to launch-lane board: /boards/launch-lane/Orchid-private-pilot.
Asha (PM): Actions: (1) Asha -> negotiate Beacon slot transfer by EOD Tue; (2) Priya -> infra template once slot confirmed; (3) Liam -> playbook + telemetry hooks by next Wed; (4) Jules -> book sec checks. Flagging as "customer-driven - high". :thumbsup:
